comment: Bridge SVP. pokemontcg.io ships an svp set (ptcgo_code 'PR-SV', name 'Scarlet & Violet Black Star Promos'), but neither its abbreviation nor its normalized name matches TCGCSV's 'SVP' / 'SV: Scarlet & Violet Promo Cards'. The auto-linker can't bridge them, so the link has to be supplied explicitly. synthesize_cards=true also fills the upstream gap: pokemontcg.io covers svp-1..165 but TCGCSV has products through ~svp-225 (World Championship etc.) — INSERT OR IGNORE leaves the upstream-managed rows untouched and only creates stubs for numbers pokemontcg.io hasn't published yet. symbol_url overrides upstream's busier SVP glyph so it pairs visually with MEP.

Synthesize MEP. pokemontcg.io has not yet published a Mega Evolution Promo set (~8 months past TCGCSV's release on 2025-09-26 as of 2026-05-24). The set row is built from TCGCSV's group metadata, and synthesize_cards=true populates the cards table from the 83 known TCGCSV products so the binder isn't empty. INSERT OR IGNORE — when pokemontcg.io eventually adds the real set, its upserts win and synthesized stubs are superseded silently.

Secondary bridge: base1's no-art-frame-shadow print run. TCGCSV splits Base Set into two productId-level groups — 604 (the regular Unlimited run with the shadow; auto-linked as the primary group) and 1663 (everything without the shadow). Within 1663 the 1st-Edition vs unstamped-transition split lives only in price.sub_type_name, mapped by tcgcsv_sub_type_variant_map for group 1663: 1st Edition* → first_ed_*; Unlimited*/Normal/Holofoil → shadowless_*. role='shadowless' tells import_groups to add the link instead of wiping the primary 604 → base1 mapping. See pokedumpster-5is.
